title: How Corporate Organization Is Changing in the AI Era
excerpt: Organizational transformation in the AI era is not merely about assigning an agent to employees; it involves rewriting the infrastructure for task handover, permission management, context handling, and result verification. This article explores the product formats, commercial value, and risk considerations of enterprise collaboration tools, starting with Grok Bot, Claude Tag, and DouBao Work Partner.
body: ## Handovers are happening in a different way During my previous internships, I experienced firsthand the change in the way interactions take place within the development process. Now, requirements are proposed by the product team, and what is delivered to the development side is a structured document generated by an Agent, including objectives, scope, constraints, the deliverables, and acceptance criteria. Once the developers receive this, they use a Coding Agent to implement each component, carrying out verification and testing as needed. By the time a PR is submitted, the code has already been reviewed by an Agent that applies relevant skills. There are also various automated tasks in other departments: for example, some of the routine tasks performed by the operations team are scheduled via collaborative robots, which automatically send private messages to the appropriate persons in case of any issues; or there’s the automated testing pipeline used by the testing team. Human intervention is still essential in this process. During my internship, I encountered two types of scenarios. The first type involves cross-role alignment: product, development, and testing teams must first agree on goals, responsibilities, and acceptance criteria, before passing these finalized details to their respective agents for planning and execution. This approach is limited by issues related to responsibility assignment, permissions, and model reliability. A more reliable way of collaborating at present is for humans to clarify any discrepancies and responsibilities first, and then have the agents handle the subsequent tasks. The second category is a concept similar to RSI, namely a model training process of recursive self-improvement. From data preparation, training, and evaluation to adjusting the data and parameters based on the results, the Agent is not yet able to complete the entire cycle reliably. Once training and reinforcement learning go off track, costs will accumulate rapidly; therefore, critical decisions during this process still require human oversight. On their own, these details aren’t anything new — the fact that coding agents can write code has been discussed for two or three years now. What’s more noteworthy is the intermediate layer in the interaction process. Previously, to complete a request, the product team would convey instructions to the developers, who would then pass the work on to the testers, who would report their findings back to the product team. With each handoff, people had to repeat the context again, and if things went astray, it took extra effort to sort things out. ==blue|In my view, the proper change should be for these handoffs to be handled through structured documents, using well-managed and efficient context as well as interaction protocols to improve productivity.== ## Within four months, three companies gave similar answers From June to September 2026, Anthropic, xAI, and Lark successively released Claude Tag, Grok Bot, and Doubao Work Partner. Although these three products have different entry points, their approaches are quite similar. Agents are moving away from standalone chat boxes and into channels, files, and work systems that employees use on a regular basis. Tasks can continue even after the relevant personnel are offline, and administrators can restrict the data that agents can access and the actions they can perform. This change can now be implemented thanks to two main factors. On one hand, the current models are capable of handling longer tasks continuously; on the other hand, the collaboration platform has made available a sufficient number of interfaces. For Lark CLI, the number of interfaces that Agents can call has increased from 247 to 767, and the success rate of these calls has risen from 78% to 95%. This indicates that Agents can now directly read from and write to more office systems. Permissions and auditing are also being integrated into the products. Administrators can assign separate permissions to agents, require approval for high-risk actions, and view which tools they have called upon. This enables companies to use agents in real-world processes. All three products are still in the early stages; while they show that the product directions are converging, they are not yet sufficient to prove that most companies have completed their organizational restructuring. ## Three entrances, leading to the same organizational change Grok Bot, Claude Tag, and DouBao Workmate approach things from the perspectives of individuals, teams, and organizational relationships respectively. An Agent first takes on a person’s tasks, then enters shared channels, and finally participates in processes based on job roles and departmental permissions. As a result, tasks within the company begin to be passed between Agents of different employees and departments. 1. **Grok Bot first expands individual capabilities** An employee can run multiple bots in the cloud, allowing them to retrieve information, analyze data, and organize results respectively. The bots can continue working even when the employee is offline. This demonstrates that a person can work with a team of constant workers; however, there is still a lack of public evidence showing how bots belonging to different employees can smoothly hand off tasks. Bots under the same account share files and login status, and their capabilities do not exceed the existing permissions of that employee. 1. **Claude Tag puts Agents into shared channels** Team members can assign tasks, provide additional materials, and check progress within the same Slack thread. As a result, different departments can assign Agents with varying responsibilities, using standard task handover forms to pass tasks along. Meanwhile, Claude tags allow users to decide on their own when to interject or respond in the group. Administrators can create a dedicated machine account for Claude, specifying which tools and resources it can use, while also keeping track of its usage logs. Channel members can utilize the permissions already assigned to the Agent, and the scope of members must match the permissions of the Agent. 1. **Doubao’s work partners retain the company’s existing organizational structure** It can join group chats like a colleague, read documents, meetings, and approvals in Lark, and access information based on the permissions of current employees. It can also answer questions and complete tasks in groups, similar to Claude Tag. What sets it apart is Lark’s robust ecosystem, with numerous OKRs, Lark calendars, Lark meetings, etc., which are highly suitable for this type of collaboration and can serve as context for intelligent agents. ==blue|The differences among the three paths lie in the context and who holds the permissions==. The individual Agent understands a person’s work, the channel Agent shares team status, while the organization Agent relies on job and department relationships. To connect them together, a unified handover format, clear permissions, and verifiable proof of completion are required. ## What is automated first are handover, execution, and verification When a task is transferred between departments, it is first necessary to pass the requirements on to the next party, then carry out the execution, and finally determine whether the result is usable. Execution is usually assigned to an Agent first, as the inputs and outputs are relatively clear. For handover, oral requests need to be organized into content that can be used directly by the next party, while for verification, standards must be defined in advance and the executor required to provide evidence. Therefore, I believe formats such as JSON are the most suitable. An Agent can take over the handover, provided that the objectives are outlined in a standard handover form, which can also be referred to as a task contract. Once the product Agent receives the task of “reducing the abandonment rate due to verification steps”, it can summarize the details to be passed on to the development Agent into the following points. ```text Task #4821 Goal: Increase registration completion rate by 5% Scope: Modify the captcha interaction without changing the risk control logic Permissions: Allow modifications to frontend/signup Executor: Dev Agent Acceptance criteria: Error messages, resending options, retry functionality, and tracking mechanisms must meet requirements Verification: QA Agent ``` After the Agent is developed, it returns the code link, test results, and risk details. The QA Agent then checks using the same standards. Human intervention is required when there are conflicts in objectives, permissions exceed limits, or the results could pose high risks. The task contract transforms the process of repeatedly explaining context into a directly readable handover document, and turns acceptance checks from verbal judgments into verifiable evidence. ## Four more constraints are needed for internal company collaboration Individual tasks can now be assigned to Agents, but four additional constraints are still needed for long-term collaboration between departments. 1. **Permissions and responsibilities must align with tasks.** Agents need to know what they can read and modify, who approves high-risk actions, and who is responsible in case of errors. Drafting emails can be done freely, but payments and changes to the production environment still require confirmation. 1. ==blue|**Only currently valid information should be retained in the context.** Coordinating Agents only need the goal, current status, and already confirmed decisions. Detailed internal process information should remain as is, with the final output, evidence, and risks provided at delivery time. Old decisions must also specify the responsible person and expiration date; otherwise, conclusions from three months ago will continue to affect today’s tasks.== 1. **Failures must be able to be stopped and recovered from.** Two Agents might trigger each other repeatedly, or they might reach conflicting conclusions or make errors in the system. Every task requires a unique identifier, a maximum number of executions, timeout settings, rollback mechanisms, and options for manual escalation. 1. **Experience must be reviewed before it can become a new rule.** A human review is still necessary; memory files from Agent iterations or process rule documents need to be reviewed by humans. Only after human confirmation can such experience be incorporated into the organization’s knowledge base for reference and use. These four constraints determine whether departmental Agents can operate in the long term. As the capabilities of the models continue to improve, permissions, context, and failure handling still need to be defined by the company itself. ## Companies will pay for reliable handovers Model and tool calls still generate revenue, and companies are more likely to allocate additional budgets to products that can handle a complete handover. Business units are concerned about delivery timelines and manpower, while IT or digital teams are responsible for integrating with existing systems; security and legal departments decide whether data and permission boundaries can be met. What companies ultimately purchase is internal processes that result in less rework, less waiting, and fewer errors. Funds may be allocated among three types of suppliers. 1. **Office suites dominate the landscape.** Employee relations, daily discussions, documents, and approvals already take place in Feishu, Slack, or Office. These suites integrate agents into existing platforms, making deployment and procurement more straightforward. 1. **Model providers earn revenue from reasoning tasks of high value.** Complex tasks still rely on advanced models, and the more such tasks are performed, the higher the revenue for model providers. The cost of switching between models is decreasing, and organizational relationships and work records are typically managed by the suites themselves. 1. **The value of an independent governance layer becomes evident in cross-system scenarios.** A single office suite can usually manage user permissions, data access, and agent behavior within its own ecosystem; therefore, if most of a company’s work takes place within one such ecosystem, there is little need to purchase an additional governance solution. But in reality, large enterprises often use chat tools, coding platforms, project management systems, CRM software, databases, and cloud services simultaneously, with different departments possibly employing various models and agents. In such cases, it is difficult to manage the allocation of agents across multiple systems and ecosystems using a single suite. An independent governance layer does not decide what data an agent should access or what actions it should take; instead, it enforces uniform standards regarding identity, permissions, data scope, and high-risk operations when agents interact across different systems, while also keeping track of all calls and audit trails. In industries with stricter requirements regarding data boundaries and accountability, such as finance, healthcare, and government sectors, there is a greater need for such capabilities. ==blue|Whether an independent vendor can secure funding ultimately depends on its ability to enable cross-system agents to reduce connection costs, manual approvals, and erroneous data entries while maintaining security and auditability, thereby truly lowering the operational costs of automated processes.== **Privacy protection** is a prerequisite for enterprises to adopt this system. The system should first filter data based on employees’ permissions, sending only the segments needed for the current task to the cloud models, and it should encrypt or mask sensitive fields. Enterprises also need to know where the data is processed, how long it is stored, and who has read or modified it. ==blue|With the adoption of such a system, the advantages and competitive edges arise from the ability to manage the **Context** more effectively==. Continuously updated organizational context, permission relationships, task evidence, and evaluation feedback can all serve as the basis for ongoing iteration of the Context. Regardless of the upstream integration model or the different types of tasks that may arise later, proper management of the Context ensures that agents can operate continuously in an environment that better meets the enterprise’s requirements, minimizing deviations. This makes it easier for these systems to be included in the enterprise’s long-term budget. Companies can charge based on each successful handover. ```text Net value per successful handover = Labor savings + Value of reduced cycle time + Avoided error losses - Model and tool invocation - Integration and operation maintenance - Manual review - Expected error losses ``` Suppliers earn revenue from seat usage or data volume, but they also have to bear costs related to inference, retrieval, storage, connectors, support, and error handling. If manual verification cannot be reduced from full inspection to random sampling over time, both customer value and supplier profits will suffer. The error rate, the conversion rate of formal purchases, and how well cross-departmental processes can operate continuously are better indicators of whether a business model is viable than the amount of financing secured or the list of products announced at a launch event. ## Risk Boundaries and Organizational Signals The most critical risk is that mistakes are actually carried out. An assistant who only makes mistakes sees the damage limited to a single erroneous statement. But an agent with login credentials and the ability to modify systems can turn a mistake into an incorrectly sent email, a flawed purchase order, or a change to the production environment. That’s why all three products prevent high-risk actions from being executed automatically. Grok Bot requires explicit approval for each shell and browser operation, Claude Tag uses narrowly defined machine identities to control access levels, while Lark secures nodes through workflows and sensitive data controls. There is also the issue of prompt attacks, where prompt injection is structural in nature. Attackers can hide instructions in web pages, emails, issues, PDFs, or data returned by plugins, causing the Agent to treat them as tasks. There are three further sub-problems: expired memories can cause the Agent to continue reasoning based on conclusions from three months ago. Automated tasks may also enter a loop of repetition. For example, a sales Agent updates a customer’s status, which triggers an operations Agent to send a message; this message is then processed by the sales Agent as a new event, causing the two Agents to repeatedly activate each other, continuously consuming tokens, and in severe cases, leading to repeated data modifications or message transmissions. Currently, none of the three companies’ public materials clearly explain these protective measures. Heterogeneous model management is particularly important in DouBao, as it allows enterprises to connect to their own model provider accounts. Data policies must be reviewed individually based on contracts, rather than relying solely on the Feishu framework. Data residency and compliance also need to be addressed separately. Grok Bot’s cloud servers are currently located in the United States, and companies need to determine where the data will be stored, consider cross-border data transfers, and review supplier contracts. If Chinese companies publish content generated by agents, they must fulfill the labeling requirements outlined in the “Regulations on Labeling Artificially Generated Content”. Organizational changes ultimately manifest in formal systems. It is more significant to observe whether a company begins to adjust job responsibilities and approval processes, as well as to incorporate the permissions, delivery, and acceptance criteria for agents into these processes, than the number of features announced at a launch event. ## Two Perspectives ==blue|For individuals, future responsibilities will shift from execution to definition and verification. The more important criterion going forward is the ability to determine what constitutes success or what is worth doing. Another key aspect is the accumulation of vertical experience in a particular industry; only when an individual has sufficient experience in a field can they develop a sense for that industry and the judgment needed to make critical decisions==. ==blue|I believe that for companies, order and accuracy are more important than speed. First, handle permissions and context management, then roll out Agents, and treat organizational memory as infrastructure rather than just prompt text. Authorization should be structured based on the reversibility of its impact; reading and summarizing can be allowed more freely, while actions such as sending messages externally, placing orders, and modifying the production environment should remain under human control. As for acceptance criteria, don’t use chat-based benchmarks; what’s worth measuring are the completion rate of long tasks, the number of times human intervention is needed, the rate of incorrect external writes, the retry rate for tool calls, and the average cost per successful task.== ## Key Sources - [Introducing Grok Bot](https://x.ai/news/introducing-grok-bot), persistent cloud computers, multi-Bot collaboration, routines, and event triggers - [Grok Bot Security](https://cursor.com/docs/grok-bot/security) and [Security FAQ](https://cursor.com/docs/grok-bot/security-faq), isolation units, identity models, Auto Review, network policies, model routing, and data residency - [Introducing Claude Tag](https://www.anthropic.com/news/introducing-claude-tag), multiplayer, Opus 4.8, memory, and asynchronous tasks - [What is Claude Tag](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/15594475-what-is-claude-tag), channel permissions, Agent Identity, billing, and auditing - [Doubao Workmate Model Management](https://aily.feishu.cn/hc/1u7kleqg/897wr1b8), [Knowledge Retrieval Scope](https://aily.feishu.cn/hc/1u7kleqg/2csyds1b), [Security and Compliance Solutions](https://aily.feishu.cn/hc/1u7kleqg/taaiminh), multi-model integration, user-based authentication for retrieval, and enterprise data control - [Reports on Feishu 8.0 and Doubao Workmate Launch](https://tech.ifeng.com/c/8wRMH4mNFWS), number of CLI interfaces, call success rates, and permission alignment criteria - [AWS Generative AI Security Reference Architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/pdfs/prescriptive-guidance/latest/security-reference-architecture-generative-ai/security-reference-architecture-generative-ai.pdf), permission-aware retrieval, input/output masking, data retention, and network isolation - [《Measures for Identifying AI-Generated Content》](https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202503/content_7014286.htm), requirements for explicit and implicit identification when releasing generated content externally

9049d454cbe224dde03ee56d6bd5dacd48aea3c3.source: 这一变化到现在才有条件落地，主要靠两件事。一方面是目前的模型已经能持续处理更长的任务，另一方面是协作平台也开放了足够多的接口。对于飞书CLI，Agent 可调用的接口从 247 个增至 767 个，调用成功率从 78% 提升到 95%。这说明 Agent 已经能直接读写更多办公系统。
9049d454cbe224dde03ee56d6bd5dacd48aea3c3.context: 四个月内，三家公司给出相似答案
9049d454cbe224dde03ee56d6bd5dacd48aea3c3.translation: This change can now be implemented thanks to two main factors. On one hand, the current models are capable of handling longer tasks continuously; on the other hand, the collaboration platform has made available a sufficient number of interfaces. For Lark CLI, the number of interfaces that Agents can call has increased from 247 to 767, and the success rate of these calls has risen from 78% to 95%. This indicates that Agents can now directly read from and write to more office systems.

88b47d183b56685083becfe871082708626d8ceb.source: 权限和审计也开始进入产品。管理员可以给 Agent 单独配置权限，要求高风险动作经过审批，并查看它调用过哪些工具。企业因此敢把 Agent 放进真实流程。三款产品目前仍处在早期阶段，它们能证明产品方向正在收敛，尚不足以证明大多数公司已经完成组织改造。
88b47d183b56685083becfe871082708626d8ceb.context: 四个月内，三家公司给出相似答案
88b47d183b56685083becfe871082708626d8ceb.translation: Permissions and auditing are also being integrated into the products. Administrators can assign separate permissions to agents, require approval for high-risk actions, and view which tools they have called upon. This enables companies to use agents in real-world processes. All three products are still in the early stages; while they show that the product directions are converging, they are not yet sufficient to prove that most companies have completed their organizational restructuring.

a3bc8ce74b1a2b1af8ed6237d94a01ff0699d8bb.source: ## 三个入口，指向同一种组织变化
a3bc8ce74b1a2b1af8ed6237d94a01ff0699d8bb.translation: ## Three entrances, leading to the same organizational change

dc8c7475fa0abcb293458e121302aa33da565b32.source: Grok Bot、Claude Tag 和豆包工作伙伴分别从个人、团队和组织关系切入。Agent 先接住一个人的执行工作，再进入共享频道，最后沿着岗位和部门权限参与流程。公司内部的任务因此开始在不同员工和部门的 Agent 之间交接。
dc8c7475fa0abcb293458e121302aa33da565b32.context: 三个入口，指向同一种组织变化
dc8c7475fa0abcb293458e121302aa33da565b32.translation: Grok Bot, Claude Tag, and DouBao Workmate approach things from the perspectives of individuals, teams, and organizational relationships respectively. An Agent first takes on a person’s tasks, then enters shared channels, and finally participates in processes based on job roles and departmental permissions. As a result, tasks within the company begin to be passed between Agents of different employees and departments.

39bb2f36dd66614611a56ed5692e4b68c5afb188.context: 三个入口，指向同一种组织变化

5c7babab6532c1da2cea5e3dfcc028b4a6a0c52b.source: 一名员工可以在云端运行多只 Bot，让它们分别查资料、分析和整理结果。Bot 在员工离线后仍能继续工作。它证明了一个人可以带着一组常驻执行者工作，不同员工的 Bot 如何稳定交接任务，目前仍缺少公开证据。
5c7babab6532c1da2cea5e3dfcc028b4a6a0c52b.context: 三个入口，指向同一种组织变化
5c7babab6532c1da2cea5e3dfcc028b4a6a0c52b.translation: An employee can run multiple bots in the cloud, allowing them to retrieve information, analyze data, and organize results respectively. The bots can continue working even when the employee is offline. This demonstrates that a person can work with a team of constant workers; however, there is still a lack of public evidence showing how bots belonging to different employees can smoothly hand off tasks.

5aabe398ab245f8fb2f0828715f59caacef45283.source: 同一账户下的 Bot 共用文件和登录状态，能做的事情也不会超过这个员工原有的权限。
5aabe398ab245f8fb2f0828715f59caacef45283.context: 三个入口，指向同一种组织变化
5aabe398ab245f8fb2f0828715f59caacef45283.translation: Bots under the same account share files and login status, and their capabilities do not exceed the existing permissions of that employee.

7b60079e730d95d01a742d63dcd2360ae5413a46.source: 1. **Claude Tag 把 Agent 放进共享频道**
7b60079e730d95d01a742d63dcd2360ae5413a46.context: 三个入口，指向同一种组织变化
7b60079e730d95d01a742d63dcd2360ae5413a46.translation: 1. **Claude Tag puts Agents into shared channels**

ef933015d866b1049d894957989ca4eaee9e6cca.source: 团队成员可以在同一个 Slack 讨论串里派任务、补材料和查看进度。不同部门因此可以配置职责不同的 Agent，再用标准交接单传递任务。同时claude tag可以在群里自主决定什么时候插话或者回答。
ef933015d866b1049d894957989ca4eaee9e6cca.context: 三个入口，指向同一种组织变化
ef933015d866b1049d894957989ca4eaee9e6cca.translation: Team members can assign tasks, provide additional materials, and check progress within the same Slack thread. As a result, different departments can assign Agents with varying responsibilities, using standard task handover forms to pass tasks along. Meanwhile, Claude tags allow users to decide on their own when to interject or respond in the group.

b42825fb2e45817f1046d7ca083f2a45eed609f6.source: 管理员可以给 Claude 单独开机器账号，规定它能使用哪些工具和资料，并保留调用记录。频道成员能够调用 Agent 已有的权限，成员范围和 Agent 权限必须保持一致。
b42825fb2e45817f1046d7ca083f2a45eed609f6.context: 三个入口，指向同一种组织变化
b42825fb2e45817f1046d7ca083f2a45eed609f6.translation: Administrators can create a dedicated machine account for Claude, specifying which tools and resources it can use, while also keeping track of its usage logs. Channel members can utilize the permissions already assigned to the Agent, and the scope of members must match the permissions of the Agent.

dae20d362c089977a26c2f910d0842e6ee59b576.source: 1. **豆包工作伙伴沿用企业现有的组织关系**
dae20d362c089977a26c2f910d0842e6ee59b576.context: 三个入口，指向同一种组织变化
dae20d362c089977a26c2f910d0842e6ee59b576.translation: 1. **Doubao’s work partners retain the company’s existing organizational structure**

3e8e25d80a263457a9380cdfcc9621a58542524c.source: 它可以像同事一样进入群聊，读取飞书里的文档、会议和审批，并按照当前员工的权限取资料。同时也可以像Claude tag一样在群里回答问题、执行任务。不同的是飞书积攒的护城河，大量的OKR，飞书日程、飞书会议等非常适合这种协作方式，供智能体作为上下文。
3e8e25d80a263457a9380cdfcc9621a58542524c.context: 三个入口，指向同一种组织变化
3e8e25d80a263457a9380cdfcc9621a58542524c.translation: It can join group chats like a colleague, read documents, meetings, and approvals in Lark, and access information based on the permissions of current employees. It can also answer questions and complete tasks in groups, similar to Claude Tag. What sets it apart is Lark’s robust ecosystem, with numerous OKRs, Lark calendars, Lark meetings, etc., which are highly suitable for this type of collaboration and can serve as context for intelligent agents.

d7cc8512144e31f477c2746a8f433f39758649e3.source: ==blue|三条路径的差别落在上下文和权限归谁==。个人 Agent 了解一个人的工作，频道 Agent 共享团队状态，组织 Agent 沿用岗位和部门关系。把它们连起来，还需要统一的交接格式、明确的权限和可以检查的验收证据。
d7cc8512144e31f477c2746a8f433f39758649e3.context: 三个入口，指向同一种组织变化
d7cc8512144e31f477c2746a8f433f39758649e3.translation: ==blue|The differences among the three paths lie in the context and who holds the permissions==. The individual Agent understands a person’s work, the channel Agent shares team status, while the organization Agent relies on job and department relationships. To connect them together, a unified handover format, clear permissions, and verifiable proof of completion are required.

fbd0ad93eeb7e7df3b8f844d5cd059186f756790.source: ## 先被自动化的是交接、执行和验证
fbd0ad93eeb7e7df3b8f844d5cd059186f756790.translation: ## What is automated first are handover, execution, and verification

5707af597fd530def0e38a8c644c4d4bb4fe9b72.source: 一个任务在部门之间流转，要先把需求交给下一方，随后完成执行，最后判断结果能否使用。执行最早是交给 Agent，因为输入和产物相对明确。交接需要把口头要求整理成下一方能直接使用的内容，验证还要预先写清标准，并要求执行方提供证据。因此我认为例如json等格式的文件是最合适的。
5707af597fd530def0e38a8c644c4d4bb4fe9b72.context: 先被自动化的是交接、执行和验证
5707af597fd530def0e38a8c644c4d4bb4fe9b72.translation: When a task is transferred between departments, it is first necessary to pass the requirements on to the next party, then carry out the execution, and finally determine whether the result is usable. Execution is usually assigned to an Agent first, as the inputs and outputs are relatively clear. For handover, oral requests need to be organized into content that can be used directly by the next party, while for verification, standards must be defined in advance and the executor required to provide evidence. Therefore, I believe formats such as JSON are the most suitable.

83d1ca4b0e409ae1f26c32cccf636fb581314c0e.source: Agent 可以接住交接，前提是目标被写成一份标准交接单，也可以叫任务契约。产品 Agent 收到“降低验证码步骤流失率”后，交给开发 Agent 的内容可以压成下面几项。
83d1ca4b0e409ae1f26c32cccf636fb581314c0e.context: 先被自动化的是交接、执行和验证
83d1ca4b0e409ae1f26c32cccf636fb581314c0e.translation: An Agent can take over the handover, provided that the objectives are outlined in a standard handover form, which can also be referred to as a task contract. Once the product Agent receives the task of “reducing the abandonment rate due to verification steps”, it can summarize the details to be passed on to the development Agent into the following points.

881c1bad0a5e14017a4be06c3d124a0995304a6b.source:
任务 #4821
目标  注册完成率提高 5%
范围  修改验证码交互，不改风控逻辑
权限  允许修改 frontend/signup
执行  Dev Agent
验收  错误提示、重发、重试和埋点符合要求
验证  QA Agent
881c1bad0a5e14017a4be06c3d124a0995304a6b.context: 先被自动化的是交接、执行和验证
881c1bad0a5e14017a4be06c3d124a0995304a6b.translation:
Task #4821
Goal: Increase registration completion rate by 5%
Scope: Modify the captcha interaction without changing the risk control logic
Permissions: Allow modifications to frontend/signup
Executor: Dev Agent
Acceptance criteria: Error messages, resending options, retry functionality, and tracking mechanisms must meet requirements
Verification: QA Agent

f8e5c22d9773b52e3cb070f1c1313ee8da1769f5.source: 开发 Agent 完成后，返回代码链接、测试结果和风险说明。QA Agent 再按同一份标准检查。目标发生冲突、权限超出边界或结果可能造成高风险影响时，人再介入。任务契约把反复解释上下文的过程变成可以直接读取的交接，也把验收从口头判断变成可以核对的证据。
f8e5c22d9773b52e3cb070f1c1313ee8da1769f5.context: 先被自动化的是交接、执行和验证
f8e5c22d9773b52e3cb070f1c1313ee8da1769f5.translation: After the Agent is developed, it returns the code link, test results, and risk details. The QA Agent then checks using the same standards. Human intervention is required when there are conflicts in objectives, permissions exceed limits, or the results could pose high risks. The task contract transforms the process of repeatedly explaining context into a directly readable handover document, and turns acceptance checks from verbal judgments into verifiable evidence.

d366de01db87d415106e6f2f42706024bfad4109.source: ## 公司内部协作还缺四道约束
d366de01db87d415106e6f2f42706024bfad4109.translation: ## Four more constraints are needed for internal company collaboration

a8cd1d155abb78340912a4699ca99c9485a7a14b.source: 单点任务目前已经能交给 Agent，但是部门之间长期协作仍要补齐四道约束。
a8cd1d155abb78340912a4699ca99c9485a7a14b.context: 公司内部协作还缺四道约束
a8cd1d155abb78340912a4699ca99c9485a7a14b.translation: Individual tasks can now be assigned to Agents, but four additional constraints are still needed for long-term collaboration between departments.

5f148c46c8dddc627914a4356c22b839b73a0c25.source:
1. **权限和责任要跟着任务走。** Agent 要知道自己可以读什么、能改什么，谁批准高风险动作，出错以后由谁负责。写邮件草稿可以放开，付款和生产环境变更仍要人确认。
1. ==blue|**上下文只保留当前有效的信息。** 协调 Agent 只需要目标、当前状态和已经确认的决定。部门内部的过程细节留在原处，交付时再附上产物、证据和风险。旧决定还要标明负责人和有效期，否则三个月前的结论会继续影响今天的任务。==
1. **失败必须能够停止和恢复。** 两个 Agent 可能反复触发彼此，也可能给出冲突结论或写错系统。每个任务都需要唯一编号、最大执行次数、超时、回滚和人工升级机制。
1. **经验要经过复核才能变成新规则。** 还是得有人工review的参与的环节，对于agent迭代的记忆文件或者流程规则文件需要经过人工review。人确认以后，这条经验才能进入组织记忆，作为参考和引用。
5f148c46c8dddc627914a4356c22b839b73a0c25.context: 公司内部协作还缺四道约束
5f148c46c8dddc627914a4356c22b839b73a0c25.translation:
1. **Permissions and responsibilities must align with tasks.** Agents need to know what they can read and modify, who approves high-risk actions, and who is responsible in case of errors. Drafting emails can be done freely, but payments and changes to the production environment still require confirmation.
1. ==blue|**Only currently valid information should be retained in the context.** Coordinating Agents only need the goal, current status, and already confirmed decisions. Detailed internal process information should remain as is, with the final output, evidence, and risks provided at delivery time. Old decisions must also specify the responsible person and expiration date; otherwise, conclusions from three months ago will continue to affect today’s tasks.==
1. **Failures must be able to be stopped and recovered from.** Two Agents might trigger each other repeatedly, or they might reach conflicting conclusions or make errors in the system. Every task requires a unique identifier, a maximum number of executions, timeout settings, rollback mechanisms, and options for manual escalation.
1. **Experience must be reviewed before it can become a new rule.** A human review is still necessary; memory files from Agent iterations or process rule documents need to be reviewed by humans. Only after human confirmation can such experience be incorporated into the organization’s knowledge base for reference and use.

00020fae3bc3208f442d16b8d091871ee42fba77.source: 这四道约束决定部门 Agent 能否长期工作。模型能力继续提高以后，权限、上下文和失败处理仍然需要公司自己定义。
00020fae3bc3208f442d16b8d091871ee42fba77.context: 公司内部协作还缺四道约束
00020fae3bc3208f442d16b8d091871ee42fba77.translation: These four constraints determine whether departmental Agents can operate in the long term. As the capabilities of the models continue to improve, permissions, context, and failure handling still need to be defined by the company itself.

1b72d9410d44f86ff5b5c16f5a59e2c921bd5c9c.source: ## 企业会为可靠的交接付费
1b72d9410d44f86ff5b5c16f5a59e2c921bd5c9c.translation: ## Companies will pay for reliable handovers

3439c19591d2bfb1bcd178ca08cd0b8ba03338bc.source: 模型和工具调用仍会产生收入，企业新增预算更可能流向能够接管一次完整交接的产品。业务部门关心交付周期和人力，IT 或数字化部门负责接入现有系统，安全与法务决定数据和权限边界能否通过。企业最终购买的是少返工、少等待、少出错的内部流程。
3439c19591d2bfb1bcd178ca08cd0b8ba03338bc.context: 企业会为可靠的交接付费
3439c19591d2bfb1bcd178ca08cd0b8ba03338bc.translation: Model and tool calls still generate revenue, and companies are more likely to allocate additional budgets to products that can handle a complete handover. Business units are concerned about delivery timelines and manpower, while IT or digital teams are responsible for integrating with existing systems; security and legal departments decide whether data and permission boundaries can be met. What companies ultimately purchase is internal processes that result in less rework, less waiting, and fewer errors.

1178e50d08cd1d68800a4793755f3bf91e6aed22.source: 资金可能在三类供应商之间分配。
1178e50d08cd1d68800a4793755f3bf91e6aed22.context: 企业会为可靠的交接付费
1178e50d08cd1d68800a4793755f3bf91e6aed22.translation: Funds may be allocated among three types of suppliers.

e94f8393f77ea3e9dfb9f5fb8e0f8c9e654de819.source:
1. **办公套件占据入口。** 员工关系、日常讨论、文档和审批已经在飞书、Slack 或 Office 里。套件把 Agent 放进现有席位，部署和采购都更直接。
1. **模型厂商承接高价值任务的推理收入。** 复杂任务仍依赖强模型，调用越多，模型厂商收入越高。模型切换成本正在下降，组织关系和工作记录通常掌握在套件一侧。
1. **独立治理层的价值主要出现在跨系统场景。** 单一办公套件通常能够管理自己内部的用户权限、数据访问和 Agent 行为，因此如果企业的大部分工作都发生在同一生态内，额外采购一层治理产品的必要性并不高。
e94f8393f77ea3e9dfb9f5fb8e0f8c9e654de819.context: 企业会为可靠的交接付费
e94f8393f77ea3e9dfb9f5fb8e0f8c9e654de819.translation:
1. **Office suites dominate the landscape.** Employee relations, daily discussions, documents, and approvals already take place in Feishu, Slack, or Office. These suites integrate agents into existing platforms, making deployment and procurement more straightforward.
1. **Model providers earn revenue from reasoning tasks of high value.** Complex tasks still rely on advanced models, and the more such tasks are performed, the higher the revenue for model providers. The cost of switching between models is decreasing, and organizational relationships and work records are typically managed by the suites themselves.
1. **The value of an independent governance layer becomes evident in cross-system scenarios.** A single office suite can usually manage user permissions, data access, and agent behavior within its own ecosystem; therefore, if most of a company’s work takes place within one such ecosystem, there is little need to purchase an additional governance solution.

3973d06234b33ef58650e50060ef0035c7d01b08.source: 但现实中的大型企业往往同时使用聊天、代码、项目管理、CRM、数据库和云服务，不同部门还可能使用不同模型和 Agent。此时，单一套件很难管理多系统多生态的agent调配。独立治理层并不替 Agent 决定业务上应该读取什么或执行什么，而是在 Agent 跨越不同系统时统一约束身份、权限、数据范围和高风险操作，并记录完整的调用与审计链路。尤其在金融、医疗和政企等对数据边界和责任追溯要求更高的行业，这类能力更容易形成独立需求。==blue|独立厂商能否获得预算，最终取决于它是否能让跨系统 Agent 在保持安全和可审计的前提下减少接入成本、人工审批和错误写入，从而真正降低一条自动化流程的运行成本。==
3973d06234b33ef58650e50060ef0035c7d01b08.context: 企业会为可靠的交接付费
3973d06234b33ef58650e50060ef0035c7d01b08.translation: But in reality, large enterprises often use chat tools, coding platforms, project management systems, CRM software, databases, and cloud services simultaneously, with different departments possibly employing various models and agents. In such cases, it is difficult to manage the allocation of agents across multiple systems and ecosystems using a single suite. An independent governance layer does not decide what data an agent should access or what actions it should take; instead, it enforces uniform standards regarding identity, permissions, data scope, and high-risk operations when agents interact across different systems, while also keeping track of all calls and audit trails. In industries with stricter requirements regarding data boundaries and accountability, such as finance, healthcare, and government sectors, there is a greater need for such capabilities. ==blue|Whether an independent vendor can secure funding ultimately depends on its ability to enable cross-system agents to reduce connection costs, manual approvals, and erroneous data entries while maintaining security and auditability, thereby truly lowering the operational costs of automated processes.==

a11a38bed89d9e9a020400bda7f581d63625713e.source: **隐私保护**是企业采用这套系统的前提。系统应先按员工权限筛选资料，只把当前任务需要的片段发给云端模型，并对敏感字段加密或脱敏。企业还要知道数据在哪里处理、保存多久，以及谁读过或修改过它。
a11a38bed89d9e9a020400bda7f581d63625713e.context: 企业会为可靠的交接付费
a11a38bed89d9e9a020400bda7f581d63625713e.translation: **Privacy protection** is a prerequisite for enterprises to adopt this system. The system should first filter data based on employees’ permissions, sending only the segments needed for the current task to the cloud models, and it should encrypt or mask sensitive fields. Enterprises also need to know where the data is processed, how long it is stored, and who has read or modified it.

7b01fb2f5ab74337b4b3117dbd3167cc81de9ceb.source: ==blue|而在采用系统后优势和护城河的建立就来自于能不能更好的**管理Context**==。持续更新的组织上下文、权限关系、任务证据和评估反馈这些都可以作为持续迭代的context，而无论上游的接入模型是哪个亦或者后续的不同类型的任务，管理好context才能让agent在更符合企业要求的环境下持续工作并且不偏移，因此也更容易进入企业的长期预算。
7b01fb2f5ab74337b4b3117dbd3167cc81de9ceb.context: 企业会为可靠的交接付费
7b01fb2f5ab74337b4b3117dbd3167cc81de9ceb.translation: ==blue|With the adoption of such a system, the advantages and competitive edges arise from the ability to manage the **Context** more effectively==. Continuously updated organizational context, permission relationships, task evidence, and evaluation feedback can all serve as the basis for ongoing iteration of the Context. Regardless of the upstream integration model or the different types of tasks that may arise later, proper management of the Context ensures that agents can operate continuously in an environment that better meets the enterprise’s requirements, minimizing deviations. This makes it easier for these systems to be included in the enterprise’s long-term budget.

ea401362d3f6ab0c2b8b1e58000bce9fcceb79e3.source: 企业可以按一次成功交接来算账。
ea401362d3f6ab0c2b8b1e58000bce9fcceb79e3.context: 企业会为可靠的交接付费
ea401362d3f6ab0c2b8b1e58000bce9fcceb79e3.translation: Companies can charge based on each successful handover.

31179b61144b2613ce4f39bc5e125bba813348fa.source:
每次成功交接的净价值
= 节省的人力 + 缩短周期的价值 + 避免的错误损失
- 模型与工具调用 - 集成运维 - 人工复核 - 预期错误损失
31179b61144b2613ce4f39bc5e125bba813348fa.context: 企业会为可靠的交接付费
31179b61144b2613ce4f39bc5e125bba813348fa.translation:
Net value per successful handover
= Labor savings + Value of reduced cycle time + Avoided error losses
- Model and tool invocation - Integration and operation maintenance - Manual review - Expected error losses

87e010dfb8273171c8f7d57c2e6ee564df5c5eb1.source: 供应商获得席位收入或用量收入，还要承担推理、检索、存储、连接器、支持和异常处理成本。人工复核如果长期不能从全量降到抽检，客户价值和供应商利润都会受压。错误写入率、正式采购转化和跨部门流程能够连续运行多久，比融资额和发布会上的产品名单更能说明这门生意是否成立。
87e010dfb8273171c8f7d57c2e6ee564df5c5eb1.context: 企业会为可靠的交接付费
87e010dfb8273171c8f7d57c2e6ee564df5c5eb1.translation: Suppliers earn revenue from seat usage or data volume, but they also have to bear costs related to inference, retrieval, storage, connectors, support, and error handling. If manual verification cannot be reduced from full inspection to random sampling over time, both customer value and supplier profits will suffer. The error rate, the conversion rate of formal purchases, and how well cross-departmental processes can operate continuously are better indicators of whether a business model is viable than the amount of financing secured or the list of products announced at a launch event.

528a8bbc482628f2a8822a986f2f48dd0e26c484.source: 最要紧的风险是错误被真的执行出去。一个只会说错的助手，损失止于一句错话。一个有登录凭据、能写系统的 Agent 说错话，会变成一封发错的邮件、一次错的采购、一次生产环境的变更。所以这三款产品都把高风险动作拦在人这里。Grok Bot 对 shell 和浏览器操作要求逐项批准，Claude Tag 用窄范围的机器身份控制权限半径，飞书用工作流和敏感数据管控把节点固化下来。
528a8bbc482628f2a8822a986f2f48dd0e26c484.translation: The most critical risk is that mistakes are actually carried out. An assistant who only makes mistakes sees the damage limited to a single erroneous statement. But an agent with login credentials and the ability to modify systems can turn a mistake into an incorrectly sent email, a flawed purchase order, or a change to the production environment. That’s why all three products prevent high-risk actions from being executed automatically. Grok Bot requires explicit approval for each shell and browser operation, Claude Tag uses narrowly defined machine identities to control access levels, while Lark secures nodes through workflows and sensitive data controls.

260f4f92049a1ad3fb1de2719892538176264b2c.source: 同样还有提示词攻击问题，提示注入是结构性的。攻击者可以把指令藏进网页、邮件、issue、PDF 或者插件返回的数据里，让 Agent 把它当成任务。还有三个次一级的缺口。过期记忆会让 Agent 拿着三个月前的结论继续推理。自动化任务还可能自己转圈循环。比如销售 Agent 更新客户状态，触发运营 Agent 发消息；这条消息又被销售 Agent 当成新事件处理，两个 Agent 就会反复唤醒彼此，持续消耗 token，严重时还会重复改数据或发送消息。目前三家公开材料都没有把这些保护措施讲清楚。异构模型治理在豆包这里尤其突出，它允许企业接入自己的模型厂商账户，数据政策要按合同一家一家看，不能只看飞书那一层。
260f4f92049a1ad3fb1de2719892538176264b2c.translation: There is also the issue of prompt attacks, where prompt injection is structural in nature. Attackers can hide instructions in web pages, emails, issues, PDFs, or data returned by plugins, causing the Agent to treat them as tasks. There are three further sub-problems: expired memories can cause the Agent to continue reasoning based on conclusions from three months ago. Automated tasks may also enter a loop of repetition. For example, a sales Agent updates a customer’s status, which triggers an operations Agent to send a message; this message is then processed by the sales Agent as a new event, causing the two Agents to repeatedly activate each other, continuously consuming tokens, and in severe cases, leading to repeated data modifications or message transmissions. Currently, none of the three companies’ public materials clearly explain these protective measures. Heterogeneous model management is particularly important in DouBao, as it allows enterprises to connect to their own model provider accounts. Data policies must be reviewed individually based on contracts, rather than relying solely on the Feishu framework.

b8dff80ea664c8763f99f72d3b8fb30fb2983750.source: 数据驻留和合规也要单独处理。Grok Bot 的云电脑目前在美国，企业需要确认数据存放地点、跨境传输和供应商合同。中国企业如果把 Agent 生成的内容对外发布，还要按照《人工智能生成合成内容标识办法》履行标识义务。
b8dff80ea664c8763f99f72d3b8fb30fb2983750.translation: Data residency and compliance also need to be addressed separately. Grok Bot’s cloud servers are currently located in the United States, and companies need to determine where the data will be stored, consider cross-border data transfers, and review supplier contracts. If Chinese companies publish content generated by agents, they must fulfill the labeling requirements outlined in the “Regulations on Labeling Artificially Generated Content”.

5e0bb24a83e7bd5002f8925b0fba98919a0bb84a.source: 组织变化最终会落在正式制度里。企业是否开始调整岗位职责和审批方式，并把 Agent 的权限、交付与验收写进流程，比发布会上的功能数量更值得观察。
5e0bb24a83e7bd5002f8925b0fba98919a0bb84a.translation: Organizational changes ultimately manifest in formal systems. It is more significant to observe whether a company begins to adjust job responsibilities and approval processes, as well as to incorporate the permissions, delivery, and acceptance criteria for agents into these processes, than the number of features announced at a launch event.

c9e45367a9a06cc7143b5876c265153098af77ef.source: ==blue|对个人来说，之后的职责和责任会从执行往定义和验证挪。接下来更重要的考核是能不能判断什么算做好了或者什么值得做。还有重要的是个人在行业领域的垂直经验的积累，只有个人在行业有足够多的沉淀，才会积累出出对于该行业的taste以及一些关键决策的判断力==。
c9e45367a9a06cc7143b5876c265153098af77ef.translation: ==blue|For individuals, future responsibilities will shift from execution to definition and verification. The more important criterion going forward is the ability to determine what constitutes success or what is worth doing. Another key aspect is the accumulation of vertical experience in a particular industry; only when an individual has sufficient experience in a field can they develop a sense for that industry and the judgment needed to make critical decisions==.

d418040172ae81ff8ad90297929b51ffd845bff2.source: ==blue|对公司来说，顺序和准确比速度重要我认为。先做权限和上下文治理，再把 Agent 铺开，把组织记忆当基础设施建，而不是当提示词写。授权按影响可逆性分层，读和总结可以放开，对外发消息、下单、改生产环境要留在人这里。验收指标也不要选聊天 benchmark，值得测的是长任务完成率、需要人介入的次数、错误的对外写入率、工具调用的重试率和平均每个成功任务的成本。==
d418040172ae81ff8ad90297929b51ffd845bff2.translation: ==blue|I believe that for companies, order and accuracy are more important than speed. First, handle permissions and context management, then roll out Agents, and treat organizational memory as infrastructure rather than just prompt text. Authorization should be structured based on the reversibility of its impact; reading and summarizing can be allowed more freely, while actions such as sending messages externally, placing orders, and modifying the production environment should remain under human control. As for acceptance criteria, don’t use chat-based benchmarks; what’s worth measuring are the completion rate of long tasks, the number of times human intervention is needed, the rate of incorrect external writes, the retry rate for tool calls, and the average cost per successful task.==
